detached_structure.evidence: A small gray-roofed outbuilding sits at the west side of the central house near the fence line, and a small gabled structure with a gray roof sits just north of the main house.

signals.notes: Large lot with dry, brown lawn and mature trees on the north and east sides; the main house has a reddish-brown roof with skylights and a white car parked in a short driveway at the front-left, and the lot looks to be on a cul-de-sac.
